faq: Will a redesign change my product URLs?
No, not unless you ask. We keep product and category addresses as they are, so rankings and bookmarks keep working. If any address must change, we add a 301 redirect and list it in the handover.
Do I need a new theme?

Not always. We can restyle your current theme or move to a proven one, such as a Hyva-based theme where it fits your budget. We recommend one after reviewing the store and explain the cost of each route.
Will the redesign affect my extensions?
Some extensions add their own storefront blocks, and a new design may need small fixes for them. We test each one and tell you early if any needs an update from its maker.
Can you do the work without downtime?
Yes. We build on staging and deploy at a quiet time. Deployment usually takes minutes, and we check cart, checkout and payment straight after.

A Magento store redesign that keeps rankings gives your storefront a modern look and faster pages without losing products, URLs or search visibility. Ecom Swift LLC rebuilds your key templates on staging and goes live only when you approve.

## What is a Magento store redesign?

A Magento store redesign is a visual and structural refresh of your storefront. It covers the home page, category pages, product pages, menus, cart and checkout styling, in a new or updated theme. The products, prices and web addresses stay the same, so the store looks new while its content stays in place.

A redesign is different from a migration. Nothing moves to another platform, and your catalog and orders are untouched.

## Why an outdated storefront costs you

Shoppers judge a store in seconds. Cramped layouts, tiny text, slow images and menus that break on a phone all say the same thing: this business may not be reliable. Even if the products are good, visitors leave before reading about them.

Old themes also hold back performance. They often load scripts and styles the store no longer uses, and they were built before mobile browsing dominated. Refreshing the design is a chance to remove that weight, not only to change colors.

## How redesign work affects results

A redesign affects results through clarity, speed and trust. Clear category pages help shoppers narrow choices. Larger, sharper product images and a tidy gallery show the item properly. A faster page keeps visitors who would otherwise tap back.

The risk is losing what already works. Changing page addresses, headings or content without care can disturb search visibility. That is why we keep URLs stable and review titles and headings, and why we do not promise ranking or sales changes, which depend on many outside factors.

## What a strong Magento redesign includes

- A visual direction agreed with you before any build begins.
- A new or updated theme, with fonts, colors and spacing used consistently.
- A redesigned home page with clear blocks for categories, offers and trust details.
- Category pages with readable product grids, filters and sorting.
- Product pages with a tuned gallery, clear price and buy button, and tidy tabs.
- A restyled menu and search that work with one thumb on a phone.
- Cart and checkout polish, with every payment step tested.
- Optimized images and trimmed scripts for faster loading.
- A check of page titles, headings and URLs so rankings are protected.
- A staging link you can review before anything goes live.

## How we run a redesign

We begin with a review of your current store: what works, what confuses visitors and which pages bring in the most traffic. We then show you the direction in simple terms and adjust it with your comments.

The build happens on a staging copy of your store, never on the live site. You open a private link, test it on your own phone and send feedback. After approval, we move the new design live with a backup taken first, and we check the store again right after.

The Basic package refreshes the home page and the product page template, with new fonts, colors, header and footer. The Standard package extends the look across home, category, product and cart pages, with menu, search and gallery work. The Premium package redesigns all main templates, polishes checkout, adds custom banners, tunes speed, checks titles and URLs and includes a period of fixes.

## What to do and what to avoid

**Do:**
- Collect your logo files, brand colors and a few reference stores you like.
- Tell us which pages bring the most visitors so we protect them.
- Review the staging store on a phone and a desktop.
- Keep product content ready, since new layouts show gaps in photos and text.
- Give feedback in one consolidated list.

**Avoid:**
- Changing product URLs for the sake of a cleaner look.
- Adding heavy sliders and animated banners to the home page.
- Approving the design from screenshots alone.
- Installing a new theme on the live store to see how it looks.
- Overlooking extensions that depend on the old theme.

## Who it is for

This service suits a store whose design looks dated next to its competitors but whose product pages already earn traffic. It also suits an owner whose mobile layout is broken or slow. A third case is a brand that has changed its look and needs the store to match.

## What we need from you

Send your logo, brand colors, fonts if you have them and examples of designs you like. We also need staff, collaborator or developer access to your Magento admin and a staging copy, or help to create one. Please never send passwords, and nothing goes live until you approve it.
